FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 195
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/15/2024
Senate Bill 195 as introduced would make a supplemental appropriation for the fiscal year
ending September 30, 2024, from the State General Fund in the amount of $10 million to the
Governor's Contingency Fund for emergency repairs of the Demopolis Lock and Dam.
